traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets power and intensity. A magnetic, high-voltage presence that others react to immediately. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Power runs to extremes and relationships tip into control struggles. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for selfhood against power, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the selfhood/power form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
shadow: Egotism and needing to be the center collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: Two versions of the decision circulate, each edited to protect its author and blame the other side. Credit disappears from one account, damaging details vanish from another, and both parties use private access to make their version look official. The Sun defends recognition and public authority, while Pluto uses leverage, records, and control of information to determine what can be seen. The square turns the competing statements into a direct fight over who gets to define what happened. One version may win the news cycle, but trust collapses around the methods used to make it dominant.
